name: Sentiment & Semantic Engagement Audit

engagement_sentiment: aspect-level tone and friction in brand copy, cited to evidence ids
cross-page policy contradictions (for example returns stated differently on two pages)
pricing, shipping or returns language that cannot be resolved to a concrete answer
calls to action whose outcome is not stated
error and validation messages that blame the visitor or omit recovery
tone discontinuity between sales pages and support pages

severity_model.engagement_sentiment: proposed by the analyser, capped by the orchestrator's promotion policy; high or critical additionally requires two independent evidence sections and a verifier pass

non_defects: marketing enthusiasm that is supported by a stated fact
any aspect the crawled pages do not cover

output_contract.abstention: returns an empty observation list when evidence is insufficient
